tiers.name: Ember
tiers.flavour: A spark most people carry and never notice.

tiers.name: Kindled
tiers.flavour: Something in you has caught. It does not go out on its own anymore.

tiers.name: Warmed
tiers.flavour: Villagers who watch closely start to say you carry yourself differently.

tiers.name: Tempered
tiers.flavour: The first true test. Past here, growth is no longer automatic — it is earned at a cost.

tiers.name: Forged
tiers.flavour: A shape has settled into you: the mark of how you have spent your days.

tiers.name: Burning
tiers.flavour: Strangers feel it before you say a word. Some step back; some step closer.

tiers.name: Blazing
tiers.flavour: Priests write your name down. Nobles start asking after you by name.

tiers.name: Roaring
tiers.flavour: Few in a generation carry this much soul. Fewer still hold onto themselves at it.

tiers.name: Unbound
tiers.flavour: The old limits that shaped your body and reach quietly stop applying.

tiers.name: Ascendant
tiers.flavour: Kingdoms keep records of people like you. Most of those records end badly.

tiers.name: Transcendent
tiers.flavour: What you do now reshapes the ground you stand on, sometimes literally.

tiers.name: Worldsoul
tiers.flavour: Myth stopped being the right word for you some tiers ago.
